outgoing.name: 20th century
outgoing.excerpt: Ytterbium is normally difficult to separate from other rare earths but ion-exchange and solvent extraction techniques developed in the late 20th century have simplified separation.

outgoing.name: Mineral
outgoing.excerpt: Ytterbium is found with other rare earth elements in several rare minerals.

outgoing.name: Water
outgoing.excerpt: A rare earth element, it is easily attacked and dissolved by mineral acids, slowly reacts with water, and oxidizes in air.
